user.title: Join a Local Electricity Community
user.description:
This HEMS has its own cryptographic identity. Send these two values to your CEL administrator, who will reply with your **CEL access key**:

HEMS id: `{hems_id}`
Public key: `{public_key}`

Keep this window open while you wait.

data_description.access_key: Text starting with CEL1. sent by the administrator (community, trust anchor and Azure access rights).
data_description.private_key: Only to restore a HEMS identity after a reinstall. Leave empty for a new HEMS.

energy.title: Energy role
energy.description:
Send the following to your CEL administrator to be enrolled:

HEMS id: `{hems_id}`
Public key: `{public_key}`

data_description.grid_power_entity: Power at the grid connection point (e.g. P1 meter).

reauth_confirm.title: New CEL access key
reauth_confirm.description:
A new access key is needed (new version of the CEL, expired or renewed key). Send these values to your administrator if they ask:

HEMS id: `{hems_id}`
Public key: `{public_key}`

reconfigure.title: Replace the CEL access key
reconfigure.description: Paste the new access key issued by the CEL administrator for this HEMS (`{hems_id}`). The identity of the HEMS is kept.

error.invalid_auth: The CEL storage refused the access key (expired or revoked?).
error.invalid_access_key: This is not a valid CEL access key.
error.wrong_identity: This access key was issued for another HEMS id.
error.inbox_missing: Your inbox does not exist in the CEL storage: ask the administrator to (re)issue your access key.

abort.already_configured: This HEMS identity is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The new access key is active.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new access key is active.

options.import_positive: Positive when importing from the grid
options.export_positive: Positive when exporting to the grid

not_enrolled.title: {name} is not enrolled in the CEL
not_enrolled.description:
The CEL registry does not contain this HEMS. Ask your administrator to enroll:

HEMS id: `{hems_id}`
Public key: `{public_key}`

access_key_expiring.title: {name}: the CEL access key expires on {expires}
access_key_expiring.description: The access key of this HEMS (`{hems_id}`) expires on **{expires}**. Ask your CEL administrator for a new one (`cel_admin.py member-access --id {hems_id}`), then paste it in *Settings → Devices & services → WattKeeper → ⋮ → Reconfigure*. The identity of the HEMS is kept.

entry_not_found.message: CEL configuration entry not found or not loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several CEL HEMS are configured: specify config_entry_id.

reserve.description: Reserves surplus published by another HEMS of the CEL. Returns the producer's answer.

config_entry_id.name: HEMS
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several HEMS are configured.

min_power_w.description: Accept a partial grant down to this power (default: all or nothing).

duration_min.name: Duration
duration_min.description: Duration of the reservation in minutes.

producer_id.name: Producer
producer_id.description: HEMS id of a specific producer (default: best offer).

config_entry_id.name: HEMS
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several HEMS are configured.

reservation_id.name: Reservation
reservation_id.description: Reservation or group id (a group cancels every reservation of a global reservation).

publish_offer.name: Publish offer
publish_offer.description: Publishes a manual surplus offer (e.g. from a solar forecast).

config_entry_id.name: HEMS
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several HEMS are configured.

duration_min.name: Duration
duration_min.description: Duration of the offer in minutes.

withdraw_offer.name: Withdraw offer
withdraw_offer.description: Withdraws an offer; its reservations are cancelled.

config_entry_id.name: HEMS
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several HEMS are configured.

generate_dashboard.name: Generate community dashboard
generate_dashboard.description: Returns a dashboard showing every participant of the CEL, with the real entity ids. Copy the response and paste it as-is in a dashboard's raw configuration editor.

config_entry_id.name: HEMS
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several HEMS are configured.

reserve_global.name: Reserve surplus from the community
reserve_global.description: Reserves a total power spread over several producers of the CEL, proportionally to their available surplus. All or nothing below the minimum power. Returns the group id and the reservation of each producer.

config_entry_id.name: HEMS
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several HEMS are configured.

min_power_w.name: Minimum total power
min_power_w.description: Below this total nothing is kept (default: the requested power).

duration_min.name: Duration
duration_min.description: Duration of the reservation in minutes.
